name: goo_gun
notes: A tank of sludge thrown in lobbing globs. A glob that finds a body bursts on it; a glob that finds anything else lands as real voxels of sludge -- it clings where it touches, slumps when nothing holds it up, stacks on the globs already there, and sets them off when it goes. That is what the gun is for: not winning a duel but making a doorway, a ramp or a pad cost whoever uses it next. Holding the right button grows one glob instead of throwing six, up to three times the burst, and keeps it loaded for as long as the button is held. It goes when the button comes up, and leaves the muzzle harder, so a full one carries -- a fat, floating glob, slower than the little ones and lobbed rather than thrown.
